description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using Lightning.js. It renders animated circles with fade transitions, meant to indicate loading state. It imports the Lightning.js Blits module, sets up properties, state, hooks, and methods for animation control.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A Lightning.js component displaying animated circles for loading indication.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the interval that toggles the alpha of the circles to create a fade-in and fade-out animation.
